notes.title: Twice Reborn coming to gaming consoles this February 22, 2023
notes.content:
EastAsiaSoft is distributing Twice Reborn on Nintendo Switch, Microsoft XBox XB1/XSX and Playstation PS4/PS5  this February 22, 2023!

To share our joy, we will be celebrating the achievement this week. 

Thank you all for supporting the game! It's readers like you who make a difference. 

Thank you to those who left a review. We still need a few more! Leaving reviews help keep this game be seen on Steam. 

Share word of this indie visual novel with your friends who prefer to read them on Switch. It's only through word getting out that Mark's story becomes known.

notes.title: Winter Sale 2022 40% OFF
notes.content:
Brrr! It's cold outside. There's nothing like wrapping yourself in a cozy blanket, holding a steaming cup of your favorite drink, and reading a visual novel. At 90,000 words total and 30 endings, Twice Reborn is made for the readers. The ones who prefer a detailed tale which explores characters, times, and places. 

 In celebration of the Winter Sale, Twice Reborn: a Vampire Visual Novel will be 40% from December 22nd, 2022 until January 5th, 2023. 

Merry Christmas, Happy Holidays, and have a wonderful New Year everyone!

notes.title: THE VAMPIRES ARE HERE
notes.content:
Twice Reborn is RELEASED! Here come the vampires! 

We are so pleased to announce the launch of Twice Reborn. It’s been a few years and a lot of work for this indie team. A special thank you to everyone who worked on it—you’re the best. 

An extra thank you for those who’ve been following this project—it’s your behind the scenes support who have encouraged everyone. Finally, a thank you for the conventions who allowed us to demo early back in 2019. It was the first time we got to see people play it—most of whom had never read a visual novel before. It was a special experience.

So what’s next? Play it! Review it! Share it! Discuss it!

For anime lovers: you may recognize Jonah Scott [from Beaststars (Legoshi), Sk8 the Infinity (Joe), Supercrooks (Johnny Bolt) , Record of Ragnarok (Adam), and High-Rise Invasion (Sniper Mask). Although he is not in the demo, he is cast as Belmonte, the leader of the Society of the Arts. 

For video game lovers, you may recognized Adam Clark who voiced in Castlevania.
